visual_review.identity: Darker cool gray-blue stony substrate interleaved with pale snow/frost sheets, scattered gray stones and a few flat pale branching surface marks. No pools, open water, roots or other identified new objects.
visual_review.ambiguous_source_marks: Three prominent pale branching strokes plus a small fourth faint one remain. Their physical meaning is not assigned in source metadata; they are not registered as ice, cracks, roots or gameplay hazards.
visual_review.detail_density: Approximately 18-22 stone groups, near but above requested density. Dark substrate has more small angular facets and mottled detail than the clean broad-plane target; pale snow remains in broad connected swaths.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main stone faces and groups are roughly 8-24 world units across at proposed 256 period; larger than initial 3-8-unit guidance. Source shifts brighter/bluer than original but remains distinctly darker than snow-1/2.
visual_review.style_caveat: Broad snow coverage and chunky rocks are readable; the dark crust is the most finely textured of the four new snow sources. No programmatic filtering or corrections applied.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 full opacity and material identity retained. Catalog-only preview candidate, no current gameplay/scene integration and no natural seamlessness claim.
